admission.justification: Deterministic, read-only, fail-closed generation of Stage 00 skeleton files and dag/dag.json requires strict models, closed-world Lean parsing, preserve_defs stub rendering, import-only DAG construction and in-memory-before-write CLI wiring to hold together.

guarantee: Invoking rh-extract against read-only upstream checkouts validates the 21-stage map, parses all mapped Lean 4 files under a closed-world grammar, and atomically emits byte-identical provenance-preserving skeleton files and an import-only DAG without executing Lean or leaving partial writes on error.
title: Phase 1 deterministic Lean 4 extractor, stage map and Stage 00 skeleton pipeline
